Protein Food

Ham

About This Entry

Ham is cured (and often smoked) pork leg served roasted, glazed, or sliced cold. Salt, smoke, and sweetness call for off-dry Riesling, sparkling wine, or fruity reds with low tannin.

Beginner Guide

City ham is wet-cured and mild; country ham is dry-cured and intensely salty. Fully cooked hams need only warming; raw cured hams need cooking to safe temperature.

FAQ

What is Ham?
City ham is wet-cured and mild; country ham is dry-cured and intensely salty.
How should Ham be cooked?
Cook to safe internal temperature; richer cuts tolerate slow cooking, smoke, and braising that build pairing-friendly flavor.
